items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: It was Shepperd -- what's his name, Freddie Keppard, Darnell Howard on saxophone...

ctx.x: It was Shepperd -- what's his name, Freddie Keppard, Darnell Howard on saxophone, Bushell on saxophone, and who the heck was on trombone? Fellow by the name of Burt -- Burt something. Used to have a club at the Musicians Union. He played trombone. But the name I remember is Darnell Howard and Sidney Bechet, Freddie Keppard.
